articles.title: gilt-cli added to PyPI
articles.summary: The article introduces a local-only, privacy-first command-line tool designed for managing personal gilt data across multiple bank accounts. Its fundamental principle ensures all data processing occurs exclusively on the user's machine, eliminating network interaction. This approach prioritizes data security and user privacy, offering enhanced control over sensitive financial information by keeping it completely offline.

articles.title: First Class X Board exam must under 2-test system, says CBSE
articles.summary: The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) in India has proposed a significant change for Class X Board exams. Under a new two-test system, the the first Board exam would be mandatory for all students. This move aims to reshape the evaluation process for secondary school students, impacting educational policy nationwide by ensuring foundational assessment.

articles.title: Can't let India be maligned, Delhi HC tells journo in OCI card case
articles.summary: The Delhi High Court recently asserted that India cannot be maligned, making this observation during a case involving a journalist and their Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) card. This highlights the judiciary's stance on protecting national reputation and sets a precedent for individuals, including journalists, holding OCI status, emphasizing responsible conduct and respect for the nation.

articles.title: You have 5-7 years to develop 6th gen aero engines: Rajnath’s challenge for DRDO scientists
articles.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh has challenged DRDO scientists to indigenously develop 6th generation aero engines within an ambitious timeframe of 5-7 years. This critical directive aims to bolster India's self-reliance in advanced aerospace technology and significantly enhance its future air power capabilities. The move underscores a strong focus on domestic innovation crucial for national defence.
